name: Kin Ship Goods
old_description: Gift cards purchased online are electronic only, you will not receive a physical gift card in the mail.
about:
Kin Ship Goods operates from a storefront at 617 Tennessee Avenue in Charleston, West Virginia. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, nor are the names of its founders.

The business runs both a physical shop and an e-commerce site, offering a mix of apparel (short-sleeve tees, crop tees, long-sleeve tees, sweatshirts), accessories (hats, totes, beanies, stickers, mugs, prints, koozies, keychains, pins), and a curated selection of books, journals, bags, jewelry, socks, home goods, food items, miniatures, children's products, and pet accessories. A "MADE BY US" line suggests some products are designed or produced in-house, while collaborations with artists such as Patti Smith and Jeff Buckley add exclusive items. No details on manufacturing processes, facility size, headcount, or production volumes are provided.

Kin Ship Goods serves primarily retail consumers, including tourists and locals seeking West Virginia-themed merchandise, gift items, and artist collaborations. The shop is open Tuesday through Saturday 10 a.m.–6 p.m. and Sunday 10 a.m.–2 p.m. There is no indication of B2B or wholesale operations.

The company has not publicly stated a founding mission or specific differentiators beyond its curated product mix and local presence.
